# Project Context

- GitHub repository: `jamesmontemagno/auto-github-changelog-poster`
- Default branch: `master`
- Azure DevOps organization: `devdiv-advocacy`
- Azure DevOps project: `Community Team Projects`
- Source code, pull requests, and Git history belong in GitHub.
- Backlog items, bugs, and task tracking belong in Azure DevOps.
- Prefer adding a work item comment when you need traceability but do not have enough metadata to create a proper artifact link.
